notes.title: Announcing an Orange Juice Board Game!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.level99store.com/pages/bullet-orange][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/1007b09870ce021e360b0314d1f3a2b72cb259cf.png[/img][/url]
Ever found yourself hoping for an Orange Juice-themed physical board game? Your wish has been heard!

We're most excited to announce a collaboration with [b]Level 99 Games[/b] to bring you [b]Bullet🍊[/b], an expansion to the fast-paced 1-4 player bullet hell-themed [b]Bullet♥︎[/b], featuring [b]Suguri, Sora, QP and Marc[/b] as new heroines!

[b]Bullet🍊[/b] is [url=https://www.level99store.com/pages/bullet-orange]now available for pre-order[/url], and all pre-orders will give you a bonus [b]Acceleration of SUGURI 2 Steam key[/b] as well!

Do note that this expansion requires [b]Bullet♥︎[/b] to play (sold separately).

You can also try the game and new expansion in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2100600905]official Tabletop Simulator version[/url] to get a feel for it!

notes.title: 3 Free Games in Stay At Home Giveaway!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4220499/3fc6a4a55e44e90abed0ca873e1ec7a83f43d139.png[/img]
Hello all!

We're announcing a new step in our #StayAtHome campaign: until [b]March 30, 10:00 PST[/b], 3 of our popular games by developer Orange Juice are [b]free on Steam[/b]: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/282800/100_Orange_Juice/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/335190/200_Mixed_Juice/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/390710/Acceleration_of_SUGURI_2/

During this giveaway, you may [b]permanently add the 3 games to your Steam account free of charge[/b], with no limitations!

We’re taking part in a global effort to encourage people to stay at home and self-isolate during this difficult time, without adding to their financial stress. 

This giveaway is the latest step in our ongoing #StayAtHome campaign. All 3 of the giveaway games were chosen primarily for their multiplayer component, and we hope they can entertain you for many days to come.

Let's all stay home and play together!

notes.title: Version 1.4 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2016/02/mj140.png[/img]

Version 1.40 makes several balance adjustments! Full notes below.


[list]Balance:
[*]Attacks now have a 10% minimum hit chance (previously, 0% hit chance was possible).
[*]Slightly lowered overall hit chance for all attacks.
[*]Single Hit Cannon type attacks are now more likely to miss against all types of enemies.
[*]Lone Rider changed from Common to Uncommon rarity.
[*]Scientist changed from Common to Uncommon rarity.
[*]Lone Gourmet now heals for 100 (up from 25).
[*]Fun Party now heals for 70 (up from 35).

Fixes:
[*]Lone Driver is now called Lone Rider.

notes.title: Orange Juice Fan Art Contest!
notes.notes:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2014/09/35.png[/img]
To celebrate the upcoming release of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/335190]200% Mixed Juice![/url], it’s time for [b]another fan art competition![/b]
Submit a new fan art of your own making to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/images/]100% Orange Juice Steam community Artwork gallery[/url] by September 1st to enter and win 200% Mixed Juice!

The first art contest gathered such an awesome selection of artworks, we had a hard time picking winners. That’s why this time everyone will have a chance to win, in true Orange Juice spirit!

Since 200% Mixed Juice! covers all of Orange Juice’s productions, the theme is free, as long as it’s related to any of Orange Juice’s games.

Prizes: 
[list]
[*][b]First place: 200% Mixed Juice! t-shirt + 200% Mixed Juice! Steam key[/b]*
[*]Places 2 to 5: 200% Mixed Juice! Steam key* 
[*]Additionally, we are running [b]all the rest of the entries[/b] through our trusty RNG machine, and 5 lucky entrees will receive a copy of 200% Mixed Juice!*.[/list]

Rules: 
[list][*]Enter a new, previously unpublished artwork of your own making to the Artwork section by September 1st with the comment "Orange Juice fan art contest" in description. 
[*]Artwork must be related to Orange Juice's games, and follow general Steam content guidelines to be accepted. No joke entries, sorry! (Obvious 1 minute Paint entries of ‘orange juice’ will be automatically disqualified from the lottery).
[*]Multiple entries permitted, but each entrant may only win (or participate in the lottery) once. 
[*]Fruitbat Factory staff will pick the winning entries at their own discretion. 
[*]Contest entries may be used by Fruitbat Factory on their social media and other promotions.[/list]

*Winners will receive a 200% Mixed Juice! Steam preorder key, which can be redeemed immediately and will activate upon the game's release.
